# Google Material Icons

The TV-specific `ic_remote.xml` is Material Icons Rounded [settings_remote](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/src/action/settings_remote/materialiconsround/24px.svg). Geometry is retained; SVG paths were converted to Android VectorDrawable.

[Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE). Other TV-specific Material vectors retain their original geometry. Settings, Tune and Back now use the [shared icon sources](../../../shared/README.md); the packaged license and notice also live in `shared` and are inherited by the TV APK.
